Check the Admin_data sheet names exactly one country

Source: R/0_data_quality_checks.R
check_single_country.Rd

new_countdown() later does distinct(country) %>% pull(country) and passes the result straight to match_country(), which itself only handles a length-1 input gracefully (a longer vector aborts with a generic "contains multiple names" message, no detail on what the mixed values actually are). Catching it here, on the raw sheet, gives a specific, actionable message before any of the rest of the pipeline runs.

Usage

check_single_country(admin_data)

Arguments

admin_data

The raw, cleaned Admin_data sheet.
